column1: Map Editor
User Story
column2: Input
column3: Expected Output

column1: User can create map
column2: 1. User navigates to map editor. 2. User presses create new map. 3. User selects where to play using the map embed. 4. User captures an image of the area. 5. User draws zones on the image. 6. User names the zones and the map. 7. User saves the map.
column3: New map is saved with the user-defined image, zones, zone names, and map name.
column4: New map is saved with the data defined by the User

column1: User can select where to play using a maps embed
column2: 1. User navigates to map editor. 2. User presses create new map. 3. User uses the map embed to move to the desired area.
column3: The map embed navigates to the selected area.
column4: The selected area is navigated to

column1: User can capture image of where to play
column2: 1. User navigates to map editor. 2. User presses create new map. 3. User selects where to play. 4. User captures the image of the selected area.
column3: The selected map area is captured as an image for editing.

column1: User can draw on image to define zones
column2: 1. User opens the map editor with a captured map image. 2. User draws zone boundaries on the image.
column3: Drawn strokes appear on the image and define zone boundaries. Faces are defined
column4: The faces are found and the zone bounds are drawn

column1: User can use finger to draw curves with pen tool
column2: 1. User opens the map editor. 2. User selects the pen tool. 3. User drags their finger across the image.
column3: Curved freehand lines are drawn on the image following the user’s input. Faces are defined
column4: The faces are found and the zone bounds are drawn

column1: User can use straight line tool for straight lines
column2: 1. User opens the map editor. 2. User selects the straight line tool. 3. User places line points on the image.
column3: Straight line segments are drawn between the selected points. Faces are defied
column4: The faces are found and the zone bounds are drawn

column1: User can use eraser to erase strokes
column2: 1. User opens the map editor. 2. User draws on the image. 3. User selects the eraser tool. 4. User erases part of a stroke.
column3: The erased stroke segment is removed from the image.
column4: The stroke is removed from the faces

column1: User can undo previous action
column2: 1. User performs an action in the map editor. 2. User presses undo.
column3: The most recent action is reversed.
column4: Action is reversed including redo, straightline tool, pen tool and eraser tool

column1: User can redo undo action
column2: 1. User performs an action in the map editor. 2. User presses undo. 3. User presses redo.
column3: The previously undone action is restored.

column1: User can save map
column2: 1. User creates a map in the map editor. 2. User presses save.
column3: The map is saved and can be accessed later.

column1: User can name map
column2: 1. User creates a map. 2. User enters a name for the map.
column3: The map name is stored with the map.

column1: User can name zones in map
column2: 1. User creates a map with zones. 2. User exits draw mode 3. User selects a zone. 4. User enters a name for the zone.
column3: The zone name is stored with that zone.

column1: User can view created map
column2: 1. User navigates to saved maps. 2. User selects a created map.
column3: The selected saved map is displayed.

column1: User can delete map
column2: 1. User navigates to saved maps. 2. User selects a map. 3. User presses delete. 4. User confirms deletion.
column3: The selected map is removed from saved maps.

column1: When a user deletes a map any replays for that map are deleted
column2: 1. User navigates to saved maps. 2. User deletes a map that has replay files linked to it.
column3: The selected map is deleted and all replay files linked to that map are also deleted.

column1: Host can change lobby settings

column4: Map and zone close order are stored

column1: Host can accept or deny joining players before they join

column4: Host can accept or deny joining players

column1: Player can send messages in all chat

column1: Map, game settings and zone close order is sent to all players in game
